_comment: Live game state. This is the ONLY file that changes week to week.
episode      = the episode about to air (picks are for this one).
merged       = true once one tribe remains. Set it explicitly; never infer it.
tribes       = player id -> tribe name. Fill in after the premiere.
eliminated   = player ids already voted out, in boot order.
edit         = player id -> -1..1 doom signal from the latest episode.
idols        = player ids known to hold an idol or immunity advantage.
my_draft     = the castaways on my fantasy roster.
my_draft is [] because the roster size is not yet confirmed (see
docs/RULES.md question 1) and the site is not yet reachable with a
signed-in session, so nothing has actually been drafted. See
docs/PRESEASON.md for the ranked board; take the top N once N is known.
my_mvp is set to the engine's recommendation from the corrected
constants (docs/PRESEASON.md). It has not been entered on the site -
that step is blocked; see docs/RULES.md.
